verification: Working copies inspected September 17, 2026; deployment versions unknown.

components.limits: Node crypto primitive only; each client supplies authentication, app-specific secret, secure cookies and persistent login throttling.

components.capability: Group-qualified option validation and integer-cent option totals
components.limits: Trusted validated menu prices in integer cents; does not calculate base price, quantity, tax, delivery fees or provider payments.
Client save response handling only; caller disables fields while pending. Authorization, persistence, cross-window concurrency and audit remain server responsibilities.
components.capability: Draft-preserving owner menu save results and response validation
Atomic content comparison and before/after save history
components.limits: JSON content compare-and-set for PostgreSQL or local memory. Caller supplies authenticated access and initializes the schema. Content hashes are not monotonic versions; audit actor is a role, not a named person. Local SQL tests do not certify a hosted database.

components.capability: Complete menu submission validation with revision checks
components.limits: Validates the entire known website menu and delegates price rules to the client. Does not synchronize a provider ordering menu. Must be paired with atomic storage comparison and a compatible editor.

components.capability: Atomic event edits and recoverable archive history
components.limits: Requires authenticated callers, initialized workroom_events and workroom_content_history tables, and JSON snapshots. Audit actor is owner, not a named person. PGlite tests do not certify hosted concurrency.

components.capability: Draft-preserving POST, PUT and DELETE feedback
components.limits: Caller must retain drafts, lock pending fields and validate operation-specific acknowledgements. One bounded request, no automatic retry. Browser drafts do not survive reload.

components.capability: Complete event/contact fields and response validation
components.limits: America/Detroit calendar and time rules; optional end time must follow start on the same date. Requires matching editor/API and atomic storage.

components.capability: Decoded, normalized and content-addressed event photos
components.limits: Node server helper requires Sharp 0.35.4. Single JPEG/PNG/WebP, bounded input and pixels, output JPEG up to 1200px. Caller authenticates and stores immutable images; retention cleanup is separate.

components.capability: Whole quantities/cents, exact totals, collision-safe cart identity and fresh-price review
components.limits: Requires validated menu, current availability and reviewed option resolver. No provider payments, durable order retries, transactional fanout or hosted deployment verification.

components.capability: Durable submission finality and atomic order/print/email intent
components.limits: Node server helper with PostgreSQL or development-memory adapters. Caller supplies validated orders/receipts; queued notification and physical print completion require separate reconciliation.

components.capability: Correlated receipt validation and bounded same-submission recovery
components.limits: Requires the sibling order-quote 1.0.0 helper and matching attempt/order APIs. Browser wrapper persists only the reference; unsaved contact/cart data does not survive reload.

components.capability: Revision-checked kitchen actions, permitted order transitions and atomic before/after receipts
components.limits: Node server helper requires authenticated roles and PostgreSQL ordering tables. Cancellation stops fulfillment, preserves payment fields and suppresses queued print jobs; it does not refund, send notifications or certify printing. History contains private order data.

components.capability: Bounded kitchen save/check requests with correlated durable action results
components.limits: Caller retains an immutable request, locks pending edits and refreshes saved records. No automatic retry or recovery-reference persistence across reload/tab closure. Requires matching kitchen operation APIs.
